evidence_policy: Exact-version runtime evidence outranks family/version-adjacent documentation. Do not inherit capabilities from Pro Fast 250610 or other suffixes unless the relation is explicitly version-independent.

single_image_to_video.family_level_lead: Current official Seedance 1.0 Pro/Pro Fast prompt guide exists, and Volcano Engine developer material describes an adjacent Pro Fast 250610 as first-frame I2V capable. This is not promoted to exact 251015 capability.

first_last_frame.family_level_lead: Adjacent Pro Fast material generally lists first-frame I2V only; exact 251015 remains untested and must not inherit either support or non-support.

text_to_video.notes: Volcano Engine developer wrappers expose broader 2-12 second parameters for Seedance families, but that wrapper-level range is not accepted as proof of the exact 251015 T2V maximum.

observed_default_resolution.evidence: T observation in D-002 with no explicit resolution field

standard_probe_observation.request: text only, --ratio 16:9 --dur 5, no explicit audio/resolution/duration field

prompt_guide_status.policy: Treat family prompt language as a candidate semantic handle, not a quality/reliability guarantee.

epistemic_limits: Do not inherit I2V/first-last-frame support from Pro Fast 250610 or any other suffix.
